_readme: Acknowledged storage-layout breaks (#1274 / #2092). An entry { baseSha256, lines, reason } accepts exactly the listed ledger lines, and only when compared against the base golden file whose sha256 it names, so it goes inert once that base changes; delete inert entries. Only CI honours an acknowledgement: it records that NO chain may be upgraded in place across the change, and the deploy-time check never reads this file. See docs/DesignsAndPlans/StorageLayoutGuardDesign.md.

acks.reason: #3437: an hourly price checkpoint now records the price guard and the price version it was read at, so the per-hour slot becomes a struct. Prelive; every chain takes the next fresh deploy, none is upgraded in place across this.

Batch PR 1 against main: #3626 gives the four per-pair lender-intent mappings an innermost slot key (up to eight intents per pair), and fields added to Storage ahead of protectedManagedAccounts move it from slot 707 to 721. Prelive; every chain takes the next fresh deploy, none is upgraded in place across this.

#3779: the per-period interest counter is retired; whether a period is covered is read from the one interest ledger. Prelive; every chain takes the next fresh deploy, none is upgraded in place across this.
